attempts.head: e8ad1fa9cdc5527619d5eaf211440d7c1b18274f
attempts.linux: Four native candidates passed package/install/validate-inspect/network-denied execution/scoped uninstall; original raw capsules and records retained in the run.
attempts.macos: TypeScript/Rust/Go passed the tested stages; Python correctly rejected the unpinned 3.14.7 default when setup-python could not provide exact 3.12.15.
attempts.windows: Bootstrap stopped before candidate capture: initial npm source archive extraction exited 128. setup-python separately reported exact 3.12.15 unavailable; no candidate or lifecycle pass inferred.
attempts.correction: Explicit Windows System32 tar selection rather than Git-Bash PATH resolution; hash-verified native CPython 3.12.15 distributions from the already reviewed upstream, not a different interpreter version or dependency lock.
attempts.interpretation: Real failed provisioning/collection attempt retained. New collector revisions require new source-bound observations; no old record is relabeled as new success.

attempts.head: 0cf9f897ae2c50915ad7ddf1d8f5c98cedac835e
attempts.linux: All four candidates passed build/package/Unicode installation/installed execution/OS network denial/scoped uninstall.
attempts.macos: All four candidates passed the tested stages, including exact native CPython 3.12.15 after verified provisioning.
attempts.windows: Native bootstrap corrected; TypeScript passed Unicode installation/installed execution/uninstall. Collector publication guard stopped at Python record; an archive without a saved record is not counted as a validated lifecycle result.
attempts.correction: Inspect path strings before JSON serialization rather than treating escape sequences in JSON text as drive paths. Preserve fail-closed field-pointer diagnostics and assert raw public outputs do not disclose actual paths.
attempts.regression: A normal Error followed by a newline is not a drive path; a fictional Windows drive path remains rejected.

attempts.head: 7744512b90a6ebb1a5724369053c851cdc3180f3
attempts.result: All twelve archives were independently hash/file verified (2907 regular files). Eleven candidate-target combinations passed the tested installation/execution stages; Windows Python installation failed on a Unicode-space prefix.
attempts.finding: pip's re-executed target interpreter rendered progress using a Windows charmap; Cyrillic installation paths raised UnicodeEncodeError. The isolated provisioner discarded inherited PYTHONUTF8 and -I ignores Python environment settings for its own process.
attempts.correction: Set fixed PYTHONUTF8=1 for the re-executed child and explicit -X utf8 for isolated provisioning/venv commands. Do not change candidate code, interpreter version or wheel hashes.
attempts.preserved: A green evidence-capture job did not turn the real Windows installation failure into a pass; original run/capsules remain available.

attempts.result: All twelve candidates/targets passed native build, packaging, final Unicode-space installation, installed validate/inspect and scoped uninstall. Linux and macOS also passed independently controlled OS network denial; Windows offlineUse remains not-tested.
attempts.archiveVerification: Twelve exact archives independently extracted; all 2907 regular files matched manifests.
attempts.preserved: The corrected Windows Python installer uses the same exact interpreter and locked wheels. Genuine upgrade/rollback and permitted project signing remain unavailable; architecture stays Draft/not-ready.
